_text.gameSummary: The moments that decided your game, replayed so you find the better move.
_text.sessionSummary: Your own slip, a quick lesson and puzzles picked for you.
_text.placementIntro: Here is one position from each of {{count}} {{category}} lessons you have not taken. Solve one on the first try, without a hint, and you can mark that lesson as known and skip it.
_text.placementSummary: A quick check that lets you skip the lessons you already know.

hanging-piece.name: hanging pieces
hanging-piece.title: Hanging pieces
hanging-piece.idea: Before every move, check what your opponent can take for free.
hanging-piece.missed: There was a free piece to take here.
hanging-piece.allowed: This move left a piece with no defender.

defence.name: defending
defence.title: Defence
defence.option: There was a threat to stop
defence.idea: When you are attacked, find the one move that holds everything together.
defence.missed: There was a threat to deal with first.
defence.allowed: This move ignored your opponent's threat.

fork.name: forks
fork.title: Forks
fork.idea: A fork is one piece attacking two targets at once.
fork.allowed: This move let your opponent fork your pieces.

pin.name: pins
pin.title: Pins
pin.idea: A pinned piece cannot move without exposing something bigger behind it.
pin.missed: You could have pinned a piece here.
pin.allowed: This move walked into a pin.

skewer.name: skewers
skewer.title: Skewers
skewer.idea: A skewer attacks a big piece and wins the one behind it.
skewer.allowed: This move lined your pieces up for a skewer.

discovered-attack.name: discovered attacks
discovered-attack.title: Discovered attacks
discovered-attack.idea: Move one piece out of the way and the piece behind it attacks.
discovered-attack.missed: A discovered attack was waiting here.
discovered-attack.allowed: This move let your opponent unleash a discovered attack.

deflection.name: deflection
deflection.title: Deflection
deflection.idea: Pull a defender away and what it guarded falls.
deflection.missed: You could have pulled a defender away here.
deflection.allowed: This move left a defender with too many jobs.

sacrifice.name: sacrifices
sacrifice.title: Sacrifices
sacrifice.idea: Sometimes giving material away wins something much bigger.
sacrifice.missed: A sacrifice would have broken through here.
sacrifice.allowed: This move let your opponent break through with a sacrifice.

mate-in-one.name: mate in one
mate-in-one.title: Mate in one
mate-in-one.idea: Always look at every check. One of them might be mate.
mate-in-one.missed: You had checkmate in one move here.
mate-in-one.allowed: This move allowed checkmate in one.

mating-attack.name: mating attacks
mating-attack.title: Mating attacks
mating-attack.idea: Checks and threats, one after another, until the king has nowhere to go.
mating-attack.missed: You had a forced checkmate here.
mating-attack.allowed: This move let your opponent force checkmate.

back-rank.name: the back rank
back-rank.title: Back-rank mates
back-rank.idea: A king stuck behind its own pawns can be mated on the back rank.
back-rank.missed: Their back rank was weak here.
back-rank.allowed: This move left your back rank open to mate.

promotion.name: promotion
promotion.title: Promotion
promotion.idea: A pawn that reaches the last rank becomes a queen. Push it, or stop it.
promotion.missed: You could have pushed a pawn through to promote here.
promotion.allowed: This move let your opponent's pawn run through.

pawn-endgame.name: pawn endgames
pawn-endgame.title: Pawn endgames
pawn-endgame.idea: In pawn endgames every tempo counts, so count before you move.
pawn-endgame.missed: There was a winning pawn move here.
pawn-endgame.allowed: This move threw away the pawn endgame.

piece-endgame.name: endgames with pieces
piece-endgame.title: Piece endgames
piece-endgame.idea: In the endgame, activate your king and your pieces before anything else.
piece-endgame.missed: There was a cleaner way to win the endgame here.
piece-endgame.allowed: This move made the endgame harder.
